subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the POC kickoff: 

Summary of needs
- Use case: real-time fraud scoring & post-transaction messaging personalization.
- Volume profile: ~200k requests/day, peak 120 req/s.
- Latency requirement: p95 <= 200ms for 512-token responses.
- Quality target: >= 92% precision on high-confidence fraud alerts in your eval set.
- Cost target: target cost/token < $0.001 (goal to hit ~$0.0007/token with quantization + batching).

Proposed POC plan (4 weeks)
1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff, data access, finalize evaluation prompts and golden labels.
2) Week 1: baseline runs on current model variants, measure latency/throughput/cost.
3) Week 2: iterate on prompt templates, enable prefix caching and batching config; run quality evals.
4) Week 3: stress tests (peak load), handover draft SLOs and cost estimates, review results.

Ownership
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel (runs workloads, config tuning)
- Redwood AE: Jordan Blake (project coordination, commercial)
- Atlas PM: Priya Mehta (data & label access)
- Atlas Eng: Alex Johnson (env & infra access)
\Deliverables
- Quantitative report: latency p50/p95, throughput at target concurrency, cost/token estimates, quality metrics (precision/recall on eval set).
- POC config: model variant + quantization profile + batching settings.
- Recommendation: go/no-go and suggested next steps for Dedicated capacity.
\Attachments: I attached a short POC plan and the eval prompt CSV for your review. Please confirm the quality targets and timeline or suggest adjustments. Would you be available for a 30-minute kickoff on Monday (Nov 15) at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0147

---
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
Attachment: atlas-eval-prompt-set.csv (CSV)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaspayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This looks good to us. A few clarifications/confirmations from our side: 
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms for 512 tokens is fine as a target; for high-priority alerts we'd prefer p95 <= 150ms but we can treat that as stretch.
- Throughput: we can guarantee a sustained 80 req/s during the POC window and can spike to 120 req/s for 15-minute windows during stress tests.
- Quality: we can provide a golden label set of ~2k examples for precision/recall evaluation. 92% precision is our target.
- Data access: we can share a de-identified dataset and a secure S3 bucket with read-only creds.

Kickoff: Monday 11/15 at 10am PT works for Priya and me. We'll loop in our infra contact if needed.

Also flagged the SOC2 evidence request to our security team; they'll need the SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx completed during Week 0.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the POC.

Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | Atlas Payments
alex.johnson@atlaspayments.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Alex —

Great, thanks for the quick confirmations. Per the kickoff today I pulled together the action items with owners and the KPI matrix (attached). Highlights / agreed KPIs: 

KPI matrix
- Latency: p50/p95 for 128/512 token windows; goal p95(512) <= 200ms (stretch 150ms). Owner: Dev Patel.
- Throughput: sustain 80 req/s baseline, spike test at 120 req/s for 15 minutes. Owner: Atlas infra (Alex) + Redwood SE (Dev) to coordinate load generation.
- Cost: baseline cost/token estimate using candidate model variants. Goal: <= $0.001/token; target $0.0007/token with 8-bit quantization + batching. Owner: Jordan Blake to model unit economics.
- Quality: precision @ high-confidence threshold >= 92% on the golden label set; secondary metric: false positive rate <= 3%. Owner: Priya Mehta (Atlas) with Redwood evaluation scripts.

Evaluation plan details
1) Baseline run: measure latency/throughput/cost on your dataset with model A & B.
2) Optimization run: enable quantization (8-bit), adjust batching (batch sizes 2/4/8), and enable prefix caching for repeated contexts.
3) Quality eval: run evaluation harness on golden labels, produce confusion matrix and PR curve.
4) Stress test: use k6 to produce spike load, measure error rate and p95.

Timeline / milestones
- 11/17: finalize credentials and data delivery + SOC2 spreadsheet completion.
- 11/18-11/24: baseline + optimization runs.
- 11/25: internal review, share draft report.
- 11/29: final POC review and recommendation.

Next steps (action items)
- Alex: share S3 read-only creds and golden labels by EOD 11/17.
- Priya: confirm any privacy constraints and expected sample size.
- Dev: provision test harness and initial model configs by 11/18.
- Jordan/Marissa: finalize commercial terms and POC acceptance criteria doc.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, atlas-eval-prompt-set.csv, SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

Thanks — we'll track progress in the shared Drive link and update the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
